name: hud-viewfinder
title: HUD Viewfinder
description: A transparent camera-viewfinder overlay for footage: a blinking REC dot, corner brackets, a running timecode, a battery and mode readout, an exposure line, and a focus box that hunts and snaps onto a point. The background is clear by default, so a host lays it over a clip; set the background colour and turn Transparent off to preview it alone.
useWhen: Over a clip of a product, a workshop or a place so it reads as shot on a camera.
An opening moment of a behind-the-scenes or unboxing video.
avoidWhen: Over bright white footage: the thin white lines vanish; set the text colour to dark.
A standalone scene: it is only an overlay.
author: Mosio

variables.label: Start timecode
variables.description: Where the running timecode starts, HH:MM:SS:FF at 30 fps.

variables.label: Mode label
variables.description: Top right, next to the battery.

variables.label: Readout
variables.description: Bottom left camera settings. Empty hides it.

variables.label: Focus tag
variables.description: Small tag over the focus box once it locks.

variables.label: Focus x
variables.description: Where the focus box locks, 0 left to 100 right.

variables.label: Focus y
variables.description: Where the focus box locks, 0 top to 100 bottom.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Shown only when Transparent is off.

variables.label: Main colour
variables.description: REC dot and the locked focus box: the one accent.

variables.label: Font
variables.description: Google Fonts family name; Geist is loaded, others only if the host loads them.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the block sits over your own scene.
